str:Concept.com:Name: Reserve Rate

str:Concept.com:Description: Banks can deposit unlimited reserves in Norges Bank via the standing deposit facility. The interest rate on deposits less than or equal to a bank’s quota is equal to the key policy rate. The interest rate on deposits in excess of the quota is lower, i.e. the reserve rate.

str:Concept.com:Name: Overnight Lending Rate
Døgnlånsrente
str:Concept.com:Description: The standing lending facility provide banks with access to borrowing reserves overnight from Norges Bank, normally at a higher interest rate than the key policy rate, ie. the overnight lending rate. The loan is referred to as an overnight loan (D-loan).
Den stående utlånsfasiliteten innebærer at bankene kan låne reserver av Norges Bank over natten, normalt til en rente høyere enn styringsrenten, døgnlånsrenten. Lånet omtales som D-lån overnatten.
